description: This Java class converts Netty FullHttpResponse objects into MockServerHttpResponse objects, mapping status, headers, cookies, and body content.

classes.name: FullHttpResponseToMockServerHttpResponse
classes.description: A class that maps Netty's FullHttpResponse to MockServerHttpResponse, handling status, headers, cookies, and body.

methods.name: mapFullHttpResponseToMockServerResponse
methods.description: Converts a FullHttpResponse to a MockServerHttpResponse, including error handling.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the status code and reason phrase on the MockServerHttpResponse based on the FullHttpResponse.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Copies headers from FullHttpResponse to the MockServerHttpResponse.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.description: Extracts 'Set-Cookie' and 'Cookie' headers and decodes them into cookies for the response.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content of the response using BodyDecoderEncoder.
